name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A rulebook and toolkit that forces an AI coding assistant to work like a disciplined senior engineer — testing first, avoiding unnecessary complexity — instead of writing messy code.
buyer: An engineering lead at a startup who has started using AI coding agents but is tired of cleaning up the bloated, untested code they produce.
business_use_cases: A dev agency installs it across every client project so AI-generated code meets a consistent quality bar before a human ever reviews it.
A solo founder uses it to keep their AI-assisted codebase maintainable as they scale toward a seed round and a real engineering hire.
A coding bootcamp teaches it as the 'house style' for how to responsibly pair with AI agents.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid onboarding/training package that teaches engineering teams how to adopt it as a standard.
Build and sell add-on skill packs tailored to specific stacks (Rails, Django, Next.js) on top of the free core.

steal_this: This is a developer-workflow tool, not a product in itself — the real weekend project is writing a 'Superpowers for [your favorite framework]' add-on pack and giving it away to build an audience.
